item.title: East Brunswick: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Broad zoning ban on data centers, adopted the same night as North Brunswick and Stafford Township after advancing through council earlier in the summer

item.title: Millville: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Board of Commissioners banned data centers citywide, calling them "incompatible with the City's land use planning objectives, infrastructure capacity, and community character." The vote killed the A1 Data Center campus, a 2.6 million sq ft proposal that would have drawn roughly 1.4 GW -- the largest data center ever blocked in New Jersey. Millville borders Vineland, where the DataOne/Nebius campus was already under construction

item.title: Bayonne: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: City Council voted 5-0 to add data centers to the list of non-permitted uses citywide, after months of resident organizing. Introduced at the July 2026 council meeting

item.title: North Brunswick: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Banned data centers the same night as East Brunswick and Stafford Township

item.title: Stafford Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Banned data centers the same night as North Brunswick and East Brunswick

item.title: Pemberton Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Ordinance 10-2026 prohibits the construction and operation of data centers township-wide. One of the earliest municipal bans in the state

item.title: Harrison Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Gloucester County township banned data centers; the exact adoption date is not given in the coverage read

item.title: Logan Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Gloucester County township banned data centers after the mayor knocked down rumors of a large facility ('Earth Station-76') the township says was never formally proposed

item.title: East Greenwich Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Adopted an ordinance prohibiting future data center development after resident opposition to the Mt. Royal Data Storage Facility, a 16,000 sq ft proposal American Tower withdrew. The adoption date is not given in the coverage read

item.title: Mantua Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Township's own public-records page confirms adoption of an ordinance banning data centers; no duration or sunset clause stated.

item.title: Alpha: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Listed among the 69 New Jersey municipalities with an enacted data center ban on the Pinelands Preservation Alliance's tracker, last updated Aug 27, 2026. The adoption date and ordinance number are not given in that source -- confirm with the municipal clerk before citing this row at a hearing.
